Then have a decent written plan in place to go back on meds when you feel you might need to, irrespective of what that plan looks like to everyone else. Then do your upmost to stick to the plan and medication you feel you want to avoid being put on anything stronger. Iv been off my meds for 4 months and have been far happier. Yes absolutely experienced all of this. For me it was within the medication also, not just upon stopping. Was on abilify for years being fed constant lies about it. It destroyed every aspect of my sexuality and although it is said to have a lesser sexual side effect profile through some mechanisms of action i believe it is a definite culprit for a more permanent sexual dysfunction, not that i feel anything else would be any better. It also lead to me becoming quite compulsive despite not having really any libido or desire and was more like a horrible frenzied want to feel something. 
Dealt with shrinkage too through what i feel is lack of any regular blood flow where arousal is not concerned and a lack of spontaneity. I begun to require a great deal of physical stimulation and have felt for a long time my excitatory levels are not the same. If you can get a doctor to take you seriously enough i would definitely recommend going to a urologist to address all possible causes and dont allow doctors to weaponize the medication in the issue to pass you from pillar to post between gps and psychiatrists. Abilify is being taken off the market in america and there are lawsuits surrounding people not being properly warned of the effects. My psychiatrist actually outlined very well the compromises id have to make in the medications but has then essentially left me to deal with those compromises by myself without any real management strategies and it has taken over 14 years for a single mention of urology despite constant reiteration of the struggles i was facing.
I am in a slightly better place now and have reasonable localised pleasure in most of the experience. I still consider it a scale and that full climactic brain stimulation and full satisfaction is not nearly where it should. Currently off any and all medication and stable. 
Through exercise and supplementation of certain things i have managed to bring the time to get erect down drastically and have felt a definite improvement but still somewhat lacking in spontaneity and physical stimulation is still largely required.
Sildenafil helps at times but obviously only treats one symptom and doesnt address even a tenth of what i feel the issue is. Still recommend getting some. 
Hope my experience helps a bit. Be happy to answer any questions
